A steric clash usually means two non-bonded atoms are too close to each other. I need to calculate distances between all pairs of atoms from different residues, and find the minimum distance. The question asks for the "single most severe steric clash", which implies the pair of residues with the shortest interatomic distance between non-bonded atoms.
